purpose: Reusable canonical knowledge, multidisciplinary G2+ readiness, independent lifecycle and publication.
use: Before dependent organizational G2+ work: assess knowledge, reuse or acquire canonical profiles, verify publication and load applicable coverage.
semantic_conditions: Changed scope, knowledge needs or escalation invalidates affected coverage; authorized preparation and independent work continue.
mandatory_preconditions: Current effective scope, canonical profile references, source quality, actual capability and authorized conditional publication.
postconditions_verification: Coverage and used versions reconstructible; gaps block dependent work only; profile lifecycle survives ticket closure.
